about_the_game:
Overview

Focus, made cute and simple. Meet Poua.

Tired of plain old Pomodoro timers? Poua isn't just a timer. It's a friendly companion living right on your desktop, there to help you stay in the zone. It'll keep an eye on your cursor, making sure you don't lose sight of your objectives, and even reward your dedicated focus.

Quietly, yet powerfully, it's designed to supercharge your productivity.

The Power of a Gaze.

Poua actually looks at your cursor. This might seem minor, but it's a clever behavioral design rooted in the "observer effect". That subtle sense of being watched during your work unconsciously boosts your concentration and cuts down on distractions.

Hear Your Goal. Achieve Your Vision.

Right after you start a task, or while you're deep in thought, Poua will speak your pre-set goal aloud. These verbal and textual reminders are perfect for refocusing a wandering mind, bringing you right back to what needs doing.

You're in control. Turn it off whenever, adjust the frequency to your liking.
Your focus won't just be about splitting time. It will transform into meaningful, purpose-driven sessions.

The Most Fun Way to Celebrate Success.

The more you focus, the more points you rack up. Use these points to unlock boxes filled with awesome hats!
Dress Poua up in the hats you discover. It's more than just a timer. It's an experience where your dedication directly translates into delightful rewards.

And Yes, It's a Solid Timer, Too.

  • Flexible time settings, down to the minute

  • Customizable Focus, Short Break, and Long Break durations

  • Clear visual progress of your timer

  • Effortless pause and resume

  • Seamless automatic repeat cycles

  • Option to display remaining time

  • "Always on top" functionality

  • Adjustable size and position

  • Transparent background for a clean look

Poua is truly more than a timer. It's a complete experience where your goals, focus, and rewards connect seamlessly. Your journey to better focus starts now, right on your desktop.

name: Poua! – Your Pomodoro Buddy & Minimal Desktop Timer
